Question_text: A student investigates how the height of a ramp affects the distance travelled by a toy car along the floor, as shown in Fig. 2.1. The car is placed at the top of the ramp in position A and then released. The car travels down the ramp and along the horizontal floor. It stops at position B. The car falls a vertical distance h when travelling down the ramp. It then travels a distance l along the floor.

Question_text: A student is given a box containing ten similar plastic drinking straws, a 30cm ruler and two set-squares.

Parts.part_text: Explain how the student determines an average value for the external diameter of the straws using this apparatus. Draw a diagram to illustrate your answer.
Each straw holds an average volume of 4.0 cm³ of water when full. Suggest how this value could be checked.
